raw_segments.text: He was now somewhat puzzled, and did not know whom to believe.
The evening before he had visited Father Ferrapont in his cell apart, behind the apiary, and
had been greatly impressed and overawed by the visit.
This Father Ferrapont was that aged monk so devout in fasting and observing silence who
has been mentioned already, as antagonistic to Father Zossima and the whole institution
of elders, which he regarded as a pernicious and frivolous innovation.
